items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] She reminded me of - what was the girl from Paris? Josephine Baker, that type.

ctx.x: Tell me a little bit about Florence Mills. In performance, what was she like?
Just beautiful. She reminded me of - what was the girl from Paris? Josephine Baker, that type.
They were contemporaries, were'nt they, just about the same time?
